prompt: Phenol + Br₂ (excess) in H₂O. Draw the major product (phenol is strongly activated).

traps.note: Phenol is so activated that it over-brominates to the 2,4,6-tribromo product even without a Lewis acid.

explanation: Phenol doesn't need FeBr₃ — the OH's lone pair strongly activates all three o/p positions. In H₂O with excess Br₂, all three positions get brominated to give 2,4,6-tribromophenol.
